records.context: Full-width row bands of masks whose flow check fits ``budget_bytes``.

records.source: Full-width row bands of masks whose flow check fits ``budget_bytes``.
records.translation: 由掩膜组成的全宽行带，每个带的流检查都能放入 ``budget_bytes``。

records.context: Cellpose's flow of a mask's edge pixel reads the diffusion of the masks it touches, so a band holds its own masks and, as context, every mask they touch, each wholly inside the band's rows. Masks are taken in order of their top row and added to a band while its estimate (:data:`FLOW_CHECK_BYTES_PER_PIXEL` per band pixel and :data:`FLOW_CHECK_BYTES_PER_MASK_PIXEL` per pixel of its masks and context; a band of a site above :data:`CELLPOSE_FLOAT32_PIXELS` counts the padding rows it gets) fits; a mask that does not fit an empty band gets a band of its own. Every mask is checked in exactly one band.
records.label: spacr.ops_large_sites.flow_check_bands#1
records.source: Cellpose's flow of a mask's edge pixel reads the diffusion of the masks it touches, so a band holds its own masks and, as context, every mask they touch, each wholly inside the band's rows. Masks are taken in order of their top row and added to a band while its estimate (:data:`FLOW_CHECK_BYTES_PER_PIXEL` per band pixel and :data:`FLOW_CHECK_BYTES_PER_MASK_PIXEL` per pixel of its masks and context; a band of a site above :data:`CELLPOSE_FLOAT32_PIXELS` counts the padding rows it gets) fits; a mask that does not fit an empty band gets a band of its own. Every mask is checked in exactly one band.
records.translation: 掩膜边缘像素处的 Cellpose 流会读取它所接触的掩膜的扩散，因此一个带包含自身的掩膜，并以这些掩膜接触的每个掩膜作为上下文，每个掩膜都完全位于该带的行内。掩膜按其最上方一行的顺序取出，并在带的估计值（每个带像素 :data:`FLOW_CHECK_BYTES_PER_PIXEL`，其掩膜和上下文的每个像素 :data:`FLOW_CHECK_BYTES_PER_MASK_PIXEL`；大于 :data:`CELLPOSE_FLOAT32_PIXELS` 的站点中的带还要计入它获得的填充行）能放下时加入该带；连空带都放不下的掩膜单独获得一个带。每个掩膜恰好在一个带中检查。

The nucleus diameter, when not fixed, and the tiling-control site come from ``seg_diameter_sites`` sites spread over the microplate sample position, of which only those with at least ``seg_diameter_min_objects`` nuclei count (:func:`survey_sites`), never from one site that may be empty.

The nucleus diameter, when not fixed, and the tiling-control site come from ``seg_diameter_sites`` sites spread over the well, of which only those with at least ``seg_diameter_min_objects`` nuclei count (:func:`survey_sites`), never from one site that may be empty.

records.context: **Time left.** The estimate is the elapsed active time scaled by the remaining fraction (``elapsed * (1 - f) / f``), the "naive" estimate. When the worker prints its own ``Time_left`` and the processing session is on its last declared stage (or the module declares none), the two are blended with the overall fraction as the weight on the worker's figure: early in the processing session the estimate leans on the elapsed time, late in the processing session on the worker's count of what is left. On captured runs of Make Masks, Measure and the simulator a smoothed rate (an exponential moving average, alpha 0.05 to 0.3) was no better than the naive estimate and far worse on short runs, so none is used; the comparison is in ``features/feature_list/938_module_progress_bars_show_percent_and_time_left.txt``. Nothing is shown before :data:`WARMUP_FRACTION` of the processing session or :data:`WARMUP_S` active seconds, whichever comes first, so the first number is not wild. Paused time is not active time: while a processing session is paused the estimate stands still, and on resume it carries on from the elapsed active time.
records.label: spacr.qt.run_progress#4
records.source: **Time left.** The estimate is the elapsed active time scaled by the remaining fraction (``elapsed * (1 - f) / f``), the "naive" estimate. When the worker prints its own ``Time_left`` and the run is on its last declared stage (or the module declares none), the two are blended with the overall fraction as the weight on the worker's figure: early in the run the estimate leans on the elapsed time, late in the run on the worker's count of what is left. On captured runs of Make Masks, Measure and the simulator a smoothed rate (an exponential moving average, alpha 0.05 to 0.3) was no better than the naive estimate and far worse on short runs, so none is used; the comparison is in ``features/feature_list/938_module_progress_bars_show_percent_and_time_left.txt``. Nothing is shown before :data:`WARMUP_FRACTION` of the run or :data:`WARMUP_S` active seconds, whichever comes first, so the first number is not wild. Paused time is not active time: while a run is paused the estimate stands still, and on resume it carries on from the elapsed active time.
records.translation: **剩余时间。** 估计值是已用的活动时间按剩余比例缩放的结果（``elapsed * (1 - f) / f``），即 "naive"（朴素）估计。当工作进程自己打印 ``Time_left`` 且运行处于最后一个已声明阶段（或模块未声明阶段）时，二者会混合，以总体比例作为工作进程数值的权重：运行早期估计主要依据已用时间，运行后期主要依据工作进程对剩余工作的计数。在 Make Masks、Measure 和模拟器的记录运行中，平滑速率（指数移动平均，alpha 0.05 至 0.3）并不优于朴素估计，在短运行上差得多，因此不使用；比较见 ``features/feature_list/938_module_progress_bars_show_percent_and_time_left.txt``。在运行达到 :data:`WARMUP_FRACTION` 或活动时间达到 :data:`WARMUP_S` 秒（以先到者为准）之前不显示任何内容，以免第一个数字偏差过大。暂停时间不算活动时间：运行暂停期间估计值保持不变，恢复后从已用的活动时间继续。
